description: cozyplan plan-write hardening. PreToolUse guard steers raw Edit/Write of CLI-managed plan regions (status/metadata/amendments) to plan_tool. PostToolUse lint runs plan_tool validate after any write to specs/*.html and reports failures back to the agent. UserPromptSubmit steers build turns to the current phase; SessionStart reports wiring drift. All four fail open. This file must stay in sync with HOOK_MATCHERS in skills/cozyplan/scripts/plan_tool.py — tests/test_hooks_install.py fails if it drifts. Hooks are launched with `uv run`; on a host without uv they do not run, and `plan_tool doctor` reports it.
